audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side all read the placeholder "Skill", but content win[] (matching the packet levelChart and Yuumi's 48.92% WR over 1844 games) says Zilean wins levels 1 through first item and Yuumi only wins at 2+ items.
audit.why: Zilean's point-and-click double-bomb combo has no counterplay from an attach-only kit and only Rewind haste scaling reinforces it; Yuumi's global mobility and healing only out-value his front-loaded kit once she's a scaled hypercarry enabler, matching content's own whys[].
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..5].side = "Zilean" and phases[6].side = "Yuumi", with rewritten why lines grounded in his kit (see edits).

audit.why: content spikes[] correctly identify the level-2 double-bomb spike, level 6 Chronoshift, and the first-item haste spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions file flags two unmentioned facts: Zilean can make an ally untargetable through Yuumi's commit via Chronoshift (R) — wait it out instead of dumping cooldowns into it — and Zilean can cancel Yuumi's channeled Final Chapter (R) with Time Bomb (Q). breakdown.cooldowns only covers the revive-negates-the-kill angle, not the untargetability framing or the R-cancel.
audit.why: Both are real, kit-sourced facts (Zilean R flagged untargetable, Yuumi R flagged channel/interruptible) that change how Yuumi should sequence her own ultimate and her all-in.
